thread:
elena: quick RFC follow-up: propose a compact validator-handshake for the onboarding pipeline. want a small stable contract so bench runners and validators can be developed in parallel.

elena: sketch: NEW -> SENT -> RETRYING -> DEFERRED -> ESCALATED. retry_policy: exponential+jitter, demote after N fast failures.

marco: +1 on state machine. suggest config: attempts:4, base_ms:200, max_ms:3000, deferred_ttl_h:24, demote_after:2. also add soft per-model budget to avoid noisy models hogging validation.

priya: golden policy: no auto-rotation by default. rotation only on promoted rollout or explicit ops swap. add "mini-golden" fallback (10 stable prompts) to unblock smoke tests if golden missing.

tess: telemetry minimal: req_id, model_sha, handshake_ver, state, attempts, elapsed_ms, golden_status (ok|missing|mismatch|corrupt), tokenizer_ver, seqlen_p50/p95, kv_cache_mb, node_id. sample full traces for ADMIT/CANARY.

ron: ops asks: CLI commands swap-golden, requeue-deferred <filter>, inspect-deferred <model>. include a short diagnostic token in handshake (ttl 10m) so validator can fetch extra traces when needed.

elena: deployment note: support single-binary and split-service modes; prefer split for hosted so validator scales independently. will version handshake (v1) and return schema_unsupported for older runners.

marco: action items: elena to land compact schema (today), tess to finalize telemetry list (tomorrow), priya to draft mini-golden runbook (tomorrow), ron to prototype CLI (next week).

elena: sounds good. i'll open a tiny follow-up PR with the schema + example payloads. :thumbsup:
